scope: Theorem 2.6 of the manuscript “An explicit power saving for the exact discrete Fourier transform” (preprints/An-explicit-power-saving-for-the-exact-discrete-Fourier-transform-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 130 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 670d0115ea2553e6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a deterministic exact algorithm applying C⊗k to an arbitrary complex array of length 2k in O 2k (k + 1)θ  time, for every integer k ≥ 0. The bound includes fixed-table construction, all scalar arithmetic, array initialization, index preparation, and data movement. Only the rational constants and i are required.
